items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: he was playing with Spiegle Willcox’s band at the time.

ctx.x: An organo — O-R-G-A-N-O. It’s a great big amp, and you had to have them come and put all the things underneath the piano keys, and then you’d turn the thing on and then it had little things — so it made it like an organ sound and he played the bass and I’d be playing along with it. But he was so strict on me. And he was playing with Spiegle Willcox’s band at the time. And Spiegle and the guys — in other words I got this thing and as the time went on, that spring, he would bring the guys in and I would improve. I…
I know exactly what you’re saying.
